src: Josh Lloyd shows, read by hand

aaron gordon.note: Body keeps breaking down, 168th and Josh says cut him in 10 and 12 team leagues

aaron wiggins.note: Low upside bench scorer now splitting shots with McCollum, Josh puts him outside the top 120

ace bailey.note: Output slipping and teammates due back, but Josh says hold him while Utah is short handed

aday mara.note: Double double off the bench makes him a 12 team player for now, helped by a teammate being out

aj dybantsa.note: Josh expects him to settle around the 150 range given shaky defensive stats, shooting and usage. The sell high window closed after a 9 point dud.

ajay mitchell.note: Josh says roster him but shop him to anyone who sees a top 30 player, the big game will not last

alex caruso.note: Josh no longer calls him a must hold, a stream for boards, assists and steals

andrew nembhard.note: Usage and assists are running hot while Haliburton sits, Josh would love a top 75 return

andrew wiggins.note: Empty line in 19 minutes and outside the Miami plans, Josh is fine with a drop

anfernee simons.note: Barely playing and still rostered far too widely, fine to cut

anthony black.note: Roster him while Paolo and Suggs are out, Josh expects a big drop once they return

anthony edwards.note: Knee procedure, Josh expects more than two months out and a January return with limits

ausar thompson.note: Promised minutes never came and he does little in them

ayo dosunmu.note: Josh calls him a must roster while Edwards is out

ben simmons.note: Torn Achilles ends his season and Josh says nobody should hold him now, so he falls off the board entirely

bobby portis.note: Minutes shrinking and he looks washed after a good start

brandin podziemski.note: Josh notes a top 70 start, better than he expected

brandon ingram.note: On his do not draft list. Achilles tear, a slow healer, likely back around the holidays with minutes limits and rest days, so not in his top 120

brandon miller.note: Usage is way up and the shooting should recover, Josh would pay a top 70 player for him and sees top 50

brayden burries.note: Rookie shooting guards rarely pay off and his rebounding was propping him up, hold for now only

brook lopez.note: Back in the starting five with more minutes, appears to have beaten out Isaiah Jackson

cade cunningham.note: Josh is glad he faded him, free throws still a worry

cam spencer.note: Fewer minutes with Javon Small taking bench touches, Josh says drop

cameron boozer.note: Josh has him playing like a top 20 player with blocks and threes next to Jerome

cameron johnson.note: Two steady weeks of minutes and numbers push him near must roster, Josh says add now

cason wallace.note: Shoulder surgery puts him out about six months, Josh treats his season as over

chet holmgren.note: Out about 8 to 10 weeks, Josh shifts the value to the Thunder bigs behind him

christian braun.note: Was playing very well before one bad game, Josh calls the drops reactive

cj mccollum.note: Bench scorer whose efficiency will not last, Josh doubts a top 100 run and is fine cutting him in shallow leagues

coby white.note: Another calf strain, the fourth in about a year, drops him below the 90s for Josh even though he likes the player

collin gillespie.note: Outside the top 200, only a deep league stash in case he starts

collin murray boyles.note: Started and logged 30 minutes, Josh wants him rostered even with his role still taking shape

cooper flagg.note: Josh says his preseason 8 or 9 was too low, the two way output looks real even if the shot cools

damian lillard.note: 25 points in 24 minutes with the free throws coming back, Josh expects a steady climb into the top 30

daniel gafford.note: Started for Dallas but managed two points in 22 minutes, Josh thinks he may be finished as a fantasy asset without a star feeding him

daniss jenkins.note: New Detroit starter running the ball next to Cade, Josh says add now though the role may not last

danny wolf.note: Chased after one big start, Josh doubts he is a real rotation player

darius acuff.note: About 40 minutes a night at huge usage, Josh rates him far above the standard rankers with only mild regression ahead

darius garland.note: Bad shooting and turnovers look like outliers that are already normalizing

darryn peterson.note: The hot run leans on three bigger usage teammates sitting, Josh says shop him now for a top 50 player

davion mitchell.note: Josh admits his preseason doubt was wrong and lifts him, but calls the recent top 50 run his ceiling

dayron sharpe.note: Assists and minutes rising with a triple double, Wagner fading makes the job safer, Josh calls him must roster

deanthony melton.note: Under 20 minutes in a deep Golden State rotation with Curry healthy

dejounte murray.note: Pushed aside since returning, the team is better off feeding Fears

demar derozan.note: Josh now calls him washed and says move on

deni avdija.note: Josh thinks his cat rank undersells him and he is playing like a top 50 player

derik queen.note: Josh says he is playing like a backup at 10 minutes and got outplayed by Watford, a top 50 talent who is not earning the minutes, still a hold

derrick jones.note: Josh calls him a roster clogger near 120 with almost no room to climb

derrick white.note: Josh sees a buy low after a quiet start without his usual blocks

desmond bane.note: Josh is frustrated, no defensive stats and little usage even with two starters out, a possible buy low but worrying

devin booker.note: Josh has him a touch better than expected, around top 25, after 30 points, 8 assists and 3 steals

devin vassell.note: Josh does not see him as a 10 or 12 team roster player. Went 0 for 8 with two steals. Fine to drop in standard leagues.

dillon brooks.note: Josh notes a hot two weeks near the top 80 but still does not see a top 100 rest of season player, a cut if he is your worst player

domantas sabonis.note: Went scoreless on tiny usage back with the starters, Josh finds Sacramento too chaotic to trust his role

donovan clingan.note: Does the boards and blocks job in 26 minutes, Josh caps him near the top 70 and not the top 40

donovan mitchell.note: Josh calls last year a one off peak, 36th now and only a mild buy low from here

donte divincenzo.note: Thriving with Edwards out long term, Josh admits he underrated him

draymond green.note: Josh thinks his assists, boards and a block a game deserve a roster spot in most leagues despite almost no scoring

duncan robinson.note: Hold for now, a drop once Duren and Ivey return and his shooting cools

dylan harper.note: Josh moved him up a lot and now leans toward Harper winning a starting job in San Antonio. He calls a fall into the mid 70s a slide

dyson daniels.note: Josh says he has cooled off badly after two great opening games

egor demin.note: Josh says he can be moved in 10 team leagues and may not be a top 100 player

franz wagner.note: Josh says his buy low is coming good after 15 assists and 4 steals, wants steadier shooting

grayson allen.note: Charlotte injuries up front and on the wing make him the top Hornets pickup, Josh wants him on every roster

gui santos.note: Josh says drop him, his minutes are squeezed and he is not producing

isaiah hartenstein.note: Josh calls him the priority add with Holmgren out

ja morant.note: Grade two strain with four or more weeks out, Josh drops him unless an IL spot is open

jabari smith.note: Josh sees his hot shooting and low turnovers cooling, aim to gain 20 to 25 spots in a deal

jaime jaquez.note: High usage without the results, a borderline 12 team piece Josh would ignore in 10 team leagues

jakob poeltl.note: Healthy again after resting the shoulder and top 70 over two weeks, Josh says grab him wherever he was cut

jakobe walter.note: Starting but shooting poorly and well short of the top 85 output hoped for

jalen brunson.note: Josh is sure the shooting comes back, buy him but do not pay a top 40 piece

jalen green.note: Josh is done with him in 12 team cats, empty production at about 200th

jalen smith.note: Started and played well, Josh rates him ahead of Claxton, keep holding

jalen suggs.note: Josh worries the knee injury is an ACL that could end his season

jalen williams.note: Broken leg confirmed, Josh writes off his season

jamal shead.note: Strong two weeks and lightly rostered, a fair speculative add though Quickley coming back could trim him

james harden.note: On washed watch with fewer assists and poor shooting, Josh now has him outside the top 60

jared mccain.note: Scorer with shaky efficiency and an unsteady role, stream only

jaren jackson.note: Torn MCL without surgery, 6 to 8 weeks and Josh leans to the long end

jaylen brown.note: Josh calls him the best Sixers target, likes him around pick 40 as more minutes offset lost usage, and took him at 39 in his pick 10 mock

jaylin williams.note: Josh rates him a 12 team hold while Holmgren is sidelined

jaylon tyson.note: Josh says he is no longer a 12 team player

jayson tatum.note: Josh says he has looked elite since coming back and expects a top 10 finish soon

jerami grant.note: Looks oddly washed in Memphis, deep league streamer at best

jeremiah fears.note: Producing beside Dejounte Murray and gaining usage as Murray fades, the front office backs him

john collins.note: Not good enough even with Duren out, cut him if he is your weakest

jonathan kuminga.note: Josh sees him as a hold for now in a 12 team format, though he doubts the role sticks

josh hart.note: Josh says he will likely skip him in every draft this year, only taking a look if he slides to around 120

jrue holiday.note: Cutting him after one blowout was an overreaction in Josh's view, add him if available

julian champagnie.note: Josh says drop him in 10 and 12 team leagues, the three point run cannot last

julius randle.note: Josh has him right around where he went in drafts

jusuf nurkic.note: Foot and toe trouble may cost weeks or months and a smaller role after, so Josh would only take him with the last pick as an IR stash

karlo matkovic.note: Not enough minutes in an odd center rotation to hold

kawhi leonard.note: Knee flared up once more, Josh would keep him out of his first 40 picks

keegan murray.note: Still a careful 24 minute bench role, but four blocks have Josh leaning toward a 12 team add

keldon johnson.note: Josh agrees he belongs outside the top 200 and expects a worse year buried in a crowded Spurs bench of forwards

kelel ware.note: Josh now suspects he simply is not good, last chance this week

kelly oubre.note: Josh cannot recommend him in 12 team leagues, no steals and little else

kenrich williams.note: Now a set Thunder starter at 21 to 30 minutes, Josh says look in deeper leagues

kevin porter.note: Josh projects around 25 minutes in a crowded Milwaukee group, which he reckons is only just enough for 12 team leagues

keyonte george.note: Josh expects only a small dip from last year and puts him in the 40 to 55 band, well above where most drafts take him

khaman maluach.note: Long term drop despite better bench games, keep only through the Phoenix back to back

kingston flemings.note: He is starting, Josh says give it about three weeks before judging

klay thompson.note: Only a threes streamer now, gives nothing else when the shot is off

kon knueppel.note: Josh expects him to miss multiple weeks with the leg issue, listed out with no timeline

kris dunn.note: Minutes are shrinking with Strus back and Ingram close, Josh says he can go if you need the spot

kristaps porzingis.note: Josh says his health is too unclear to draft him right now

kyshawn george.note: Josh would sell before Avdija returns and takes touches away

lamelo ball.note: Second hamstring strain in a row, out at least four weeks, fine to cut for the IL spot

leaky black.note: Standard ranks flatter him on steals and no turnovers, Josh says the tiny scoring line is not worth an add

malik monk.note: Minutes collapsed after a brief good stretch and the Kings play twice in a week, Josh says cut

matas buzelis.note: Comfortable without Pau, worth a grab if dropped though the move to small forward cut his blocks

matisse thybulle.note: Josh says his steals are close to elite, and at 28 minutes a night he must be rostered

max strus.note: Josh calls him a fringe 12 team must roster player, 23 minutes with assists, threes and boards, and the 29 percent shooting will not last

meleek thomas.note: Cavs bench scorer ahead of Tyson and Merrill, a must add if Harden or Mitchell sits

mikal bridges.note: Only 17 minutes in a blowout, Josh already cut him and sees no reason to roster him

mikel brown.note: Back from injury, Josh thinks about 25 bench minutes is enough to stream and expects a starting job in time

miles bridges.note: Second quiet game in a row, the slide Josh expected from an unsustainable start

morez johnson.note: Big rebounding night makes him a speculative add, crowded frontcourt caps it

moritz wagner.note: Josh says to drop whatever is left of him now with Brooklyn playing only twice

moussa diabate.note: Josh doubts he holds a top 90 pace and would shop him to see what extra comes back

myles turner.note: Three points on awful shooting, Josh says he looks out of shape and is fine cutting him

naji marshall.note: Josh no longer sees him as a 10 or 12 team must roster player now that Aldama is back, a stream only

naz reid.note: Efficiency should improve and usage jumped with teammates out, Josh leans buy

neemias queta.note: Josh calls him a must hold in 12 team leagues if he keeps starting over Robinson near 29 minutes, posted 9 and 12 with 2 blocks

nic claxton.note: Josh no longer thinks he is good and doubts a steady starting role

nickeil alexander walker.show: Rankings that do not add up
nickeil alexander walker.note: Josh projects him around 35th with no real change in role, so Yahoo sliding him toward 58 is a gift in his eyes

nikola jokic.note: Has not looked like himself all season and the outside shot keeps slipping

nikola vucevic.note: Josh says he is done for now after only five minutes as the third center behind Wendell Carter, revisit only if his role comes back

nolan traore.note: Steals and shooting run far over what Josh expects and his starts go once Demin is back, may end up droppable

obi toppin.note: Rostered far too widely for empty production

onyeka okongwu.note: Threes, boards and finishing all run above expected with oddly few turnovers, Josh would not pay a top 45 price and would sell for a top 50 player

oso ighodaro.note: Josh was let down by the first start, 24 quiet minutes with barely a shot, and wants 28 or 29 minutes before he matters in 12 team leagues

paolo banchero.note: For cats Josh now likes him somewhere in the 50s or early 60s, much higher in Yahoo points, and calls him the top Magic target if he slides

paul george.note: Scored 36 and the knees are holding, Josh would only move him for a top 30 type return

paul reed.note: Detroit moved him to the bench and Josh thinks the role is permanent

payton pritchard.note: Josh says he sits outside the top 100 and needs too many things to break right

pelle larsson.note: Josh thinks an honest look at a 12 team roster puts him last and backs the drop since Miami has only two games this week

peyton watson.note: Josh notes usage near 31 lately and more volume than he expected, inside the top 100

precious achiuwa.note: Weak production and poor free throws with a Kings starter returning, safe to cut

quentin grimes.note: Only useful on nights Luka sits

quenton jackson.note: Josh keeps being impressed and wants him starting, with a busy end to the week

reed sheppard.note: Too unreliable to be must roster, a streamer only

robert williams.note: After he sat a healthy night and then got only 14 minutes, Josh says cut him

rudy gobert.note: Josh thinks he looks finished and close to droppable

rui hachimura.note: Same low ceiling as ever, Josh expects him to be droppable once Brandon Ingram is back

ryan conwell.note: Josh says add in 16 team leagues and stream in 12 after 30 minutes off the Miami bench with 3 threes and 3 steals

ryan rollins.note: Under 20 minutes on 38 percent shooting with no way back to starting, Josh gives him one last look before dropping

saddiq bey.note: Bench scorer who needs big usage and hot shooting, stream only

sandro mamukelashvili.note: Josh sees him as a fringe end of roster big after a quiet five shot night and is fine dropping him for Missi or Diabate

santi aldama.note: Unlikely to play both ends of the back to back, Josh does not get the adds

scoot henderson.note: Lost his starting spot to Cissoko, Josh is not adding him and leans toward a drop

stephen curry.note: Sitting every back to back, Josh would take any top 15 player for him

stephon castle.note: Shooting badly on heavy usage and 115th over two weeks, Josh still expects him to improve

tari eason.note: Efficient across many cats even in short minutes, Josh says he deserves a 12 team spot

terrence shannon.note: His minutes floor fell to 18 and he looked bad, Josh no longer holds him

tobias harris.note: Josh expects the calf strain to keep him out at the start, sees him as a bench forward and says skip him in 12 team leagues

toumani camara.note: Josh calls the top 60 start a big sell high that will not last

trae young.note: Josh slots him at 33 overall since he sees fewer minutes and usage below 30 again, more a round three pick than a round two one

tre jones.note: Not a 12 team player and Chicago has a light schedule

trey murphy.note: Usage finally climbing after staying oddly low all season

tristan da silva.note: Josh calls him a clear 14 team player and not a 12 team guy even after four threes

ty jerome.note: Shooting from three and his assist to turnover ratio sit under his history, Josh expects him back in the 20 to 40 range

tyrese maxey.note: Josh admits he is lower than most and would not be surprised by a finish in the middle to late teens with less of the ball

vj edgecombe.note: Josh says the quiet nights are who he is unless teammates sit, a player in the 80s to 90s with the odd big game

walker kessler.note: Steals look like a new skill that raises his ceiling

wendell carter.note: More minutes are real, yet the threes and boards sit above expected and his usage is slipping, Josh sees him settling near 100

yaxel lendeborg.note: Top rookie so far in Josh view and a draft day bargain, heavy usage but the giveaways sting

yves missi.note: Josh is sure his hot October start will not return with him, since Watford, Queen and Matkovic now split the center minutes

zaccharie risacher.note: Production faded and Walter Clayton Jr. plays ahead of him, Josh says drop

zach edey.note: Minutes and usage are not growing fast enough, Josh gives him a few more weeks

zach lavine.note: Josh lifted him into his top 65 and would only sell for a top 40 return

ziaire williams.note: Josh thinks his rank leans on very low turnovers and steals and calls him a 12 team cut

zion williamson.note: Steals are twice his norm and fading, the finishing is too hot and his playmaking shrank, Josh says sell for a top 40 player
